senses.gloss: f. (πλατεῖα, sub. ὁδός, platea) wide street, highway; open place (corresp. to h. רְחוֹב).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 6a:8">Sabb. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>המוציא מחנות לפ׳</he> he that carries an object from the shop to the street (or open place).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>וכל פ׳ ופ׳ עשרין</he> (<cite ref="P00342"><he>העיר</he></cite>) <he>וכ׳</he> and each open place in Jerusalem had twenty-four alleys.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:9">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 51:23">Is. LI, 23</cite> <he>וכחוץ</he>) <he>מה פ׳ זו מבלה וכ׳</he> as the highway wears out the passers-by, but itself remains, so shall thy children &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 337">Yalk. Is. 337</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69">Gen. R. s. 69</cite> <cite ref="Q01022"><he>פלטירה</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 161:1">Yalk. Sam. 161</cite>; Tanḥ. T’tsav 3 ed. Bub. <he>רמז לכבשן ונעשה פ׳</he> the Lord motioned to the furnace (in a depression), and it became a level surface; Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 161:1">ib.</cite> <he>פלניי׳</he> (corr. acc.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 978:1">Yalk. Koh. 978</cite> <he>הציף … והשוהו לארץ וכ׳</he>; v.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:1:4">Y. Sabb. I, 2ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>פתוחין לפ׳ אחת</he> (not <he>לפלטית</he>) opening to the same open place or street; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6:4">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>חוץ לפ׳</he>, read: <he>לפלטיר</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01027"><he>פַּלְטֵר</he> II</cite>.—

<cite ref="Makkot 24a">Macc. 24ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00189"><he>פּוּטְיוֹלִין</he></cite>.]—Pl. <cite ref="Q01015"><he>פְּלַטְיוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01012"><he>פְּלַטְיָאוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01010"><he>פְּלַטְיי׳</he></cite>. Y. Sabb. l. c. <he>פתוחים לשתי פ׳</he> opening each to a different street. Lam. R. l. c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:9">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>; s. 69; Yalk. Is. l. c. <he>מרביצין אותן בפלטריות וכ׳</he> (<he>בפולטר׳</he>, read <cite ref="J00000"><he>י</he></cite> for <cite ref="T00000"><he>ר</he></cite>) they laid them down (like paving stones) in the streets and passed rammers over them.
Gen. R. s. 31; Yalk. ib. 53 פלטיאות aisles, v. supra.
